source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U01: Apply lawful consideration,exceptions,certainty and capacity

payload.title: Check the exchange and the party at the relevant time
payload.core_explanation_md:
Consideration concerns the act, abstinence or promise done at the promisor desire; it need not be a cash payment handed over personally by the promisee. An agreement without consideration requires a specific legal exception, not a general label such as family arrangement. The source described love-and-affection route has cumulative relationship, writing and registration conditions.

The object must be lawful and the obligation sufficiently certain and possible. Capacity is tested using majority, sound mind and applicable disqualification. Soundness concerns understanding and rational judgment at contracting time. A general reputation for competence does not establish capacity during a particular disabling episode.

self_check.prompt_text: Is every family gift promise an enforceable consideration-free contract?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The applicable exception and all its conditions matter.

payload.stem_md: A family promise is treated as enforceable solely because the parties are related. What is missing from the described exception analysis?

options.text_md: Only the amount written in large print
options.explanation_md: Typography does not establish the exception.

options.text_md: The applicable exception and its cumulative legal conditions
options.explanation_md: Relationship alone does not satisfy every requirement.

options.text_md: A rule that relatives can never contract
options.explanation_md: Related persons can enter valid arrangements.
That does not establish consideration or an exception.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Relationship alone does not satisfy every requirement.

payload.stem_md: A person ordinarily competent cannot understand the agreement at the stipulated signing time. Which issue must be assessed?

options.text_md: The size of the proposed loan
options.explanation_md: Amount does not itself prove understanding.

options.text_md: A presumption that every signature cures incapacity
Understanding and rational judgment at the time of contracting
options.explanation_md: Apply the source time-specific capacity test.
